name: Telemetry Pattern Recognition Pop
purpose: Treat Grave Memory, Vascular Rhythm, and Silt Pressure as a true 3D chemistry cloud: publish exact relative telemetry, recognize a small set of meaningful stable geometric patterns, and confirm each newly entered pattern with a short one-shot Core animation pop.
inherits: HC-024D2 ten whole-Core topology visual states

recognizedPatterns.label: Pair + Counterpoint
recognizedPatterns.signal: one tight pair with a clearly isolated third

recognizedPatterns.label: Radial Ladder
recognizedPatterns.signal: large radial span with near-linear depth alignment

recognizedPatterns.label: Linear Channel
recognizedPatterns.signal: low triangle area across a long three-point line

recognizedPatterns.label: Balanced Triad
recognizedPatterns.signal: broad, near-even triangle with low centroid polarization
recognizedPatterns.pop: synchronized three-point / nucleus / mantle / membrane pulse

acceptance: P quick-test default arrangement can resolve a recognized pattern without changing progression.
Dragging through a pattern does not commit/pop until the Guide places the piece and the telemetry is stable.
Entering a new recognized pattern produces a brief visibly distinct body animation pop.
Remaining in the same pattern does not repeatedly pop.
Leaving and later re-entering that pattern may pop again.
World movement, contact, collision, progression, geography, and route logic are unchanged.
